WHO writes about this outbreak from outside the response, in English, on its own schedule. Two publications are held here.

## Weekly external situation reports

Published by the WHO Regional Office for Africa as PDFs in IRIS, and republished here as text so they can be searched, linked and quoted. 19 reports, 2026-05-18 to 2026-09-20.

::: {#afro}
:::
